fact: 1910年6月3日，阿蒙森乘南森用过的「前进号」（Fram）离开奥斯陆南下。离港时除他哥哥外无人知道目的地是南极而非北极；船到马德拉后他才向船员说明，并发电报给斯科特：「谨告知前进号正前往南极」。1911年1月14日，探险队抵达罗斯冰架东缘的鲸湾，建立大本营「Framheim」，营址比斯科特的营地离极点近约60英里（100公里）。

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Encyclopaedia Britannica）
sources.quote: When Amundsen left Norway in June 1910 no one but his brother knew that he was heading for the South Pole instead of the North. He sailed the Fram directly from the Madeira Islands to the Bay of Whales, Antarctica, along the Ross Sea. The base he set up there was 60 miles (100 km) closer to the pole than the Antarctic base of the English explorer Robert Falcon Scott, who was heading a rival expedition with the same goal.

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Wikiwand，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: Using the ship Fram, earlier used by Fridtjof Nansen, Amundsen left Oslo for the south on 3 June 1910. At Madeira, Amundsen alerted his men that they would be heading to Antarctica, and sent a telegram to Scott: "Beg to inform you Fram proceeding Antarctic – Amundsen."

fact: 1911年2月至10月，阿蒙森沿罗斯冰架向南纬80度、81度、82度三个纬度点布设补给站，为往返极点预先屯粮。9月8日，约翰森、普雷斯特鲁德、斯图贝鲁德等组成的小队提前出发，因气温过低被迫折返；艰苦的撤退在队内引发争吵，阿蒙森随后把约翰森等三人改派去探查爱德华七世地，不再参加冲极点的主队。

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Wikiwand，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: Using skis and dog sleds for transportation, Amundsen and his men created supply depots at 80°, 81° and 82° South on the Barrier, along a line directly south to the Pole. ... A small group, including Hjalmar Johansen, Kristian Prestrud and Jørgen Stubberud, set out on 8 September, but had to abandon their trek due to extreme temperatures. The painful retreat caused a quarrel within the group, and Amundsen sent Johansen and the other two men to explore King Edward VII Land.

fact: 1911年10月19日，阿蒙森率比阿兰德、汉森、哈塞尔、维斯廷共5人、4架雪橇、52只狗离开Framheim；沿此前不为人知的阿克塞尔·海伯格冰川行进，11月21日用四天爬上极地高原边缘。12月14日，5人与16只狗抵达南极点，扎营取名「Polheim」，并把高原命名为哈康七世高原；12月17日返程，1912年1月25日回到Framheim，仅剩11只狗。1912年3月7日，阿蒙森在澳大利亚霍巴特公开宣布到达极点。

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Encyclopaedia Britannica）
sources.quote: Amundsen set out with 4 companions, 52 dogs, and 4 sledges on October 19, 1911, and, after encountering good weather, arrived at the South Pole on December 14. The explorers recorded scientific data at the pole before beginning the return journey on December 17, and they safely reached their base at the Bay of Whales on January 25, 1912.

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Wikiwand，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: They took four sledges and 52 dogs. Using a route along the previously unknown Axel Heiberg Glacier, they arrived at the edge of the Polar Plateau on 21 November after a four-day climb. The team and 16 dogs arrived at the pole on 14 December ... The team arrived at Framheim on 25 January 1912, with 11 surviving dogs. ... Amundsen publicly announced his success on 7 March 1912.

fact: 斯科特的英国探险队于1912年1月17日抵达南极点，比阿蒙森晚一个月；其五人小队在返程途中全部死亡。两支队伍走的是不同路线：阿蒙森队滑雪并用狗拉雪橇，经阿克塞尔·海伯格冰川；斯科特队徒步、用西伯利亚矮种马，经比尔德莫尔冰川。

sources.title: Antarctica: Discovery of the Antarctic poles（Encyclopaedia Britannica）
sources.quote: on December 14, 1911, Norwegian explorer Roald Amundsen of the Norwegian Antarctic Expedition of 1910–12 reached it. One month later, on January 17, 1912, Scott of the British Antarctic Terra Nova Expedition of 1910–13 also reached the South Pole. Whereas Amundsen's party of skiers and dog teams, using the Axel Heiberg Glacier route, arrived back at Framheim Station at the Bay of Whales with little difficulty, Scott's polar party ... traveled on foot using the Beardmore Glacier route and perished on the Ross Ice Shelf.

fact: 在这条路线上，狗既是交通工具也是口粮储备：队伍带52只狗出发，到极点剩16只，回到Framheim只剩11只，差额被沿途宰杀充作鲜肉。阿蒙森在记述中称吃狗肉「绝不是什么真正的苦事」。预先布设的补给站不足以支撑全程，因此必须在途中以狗补粮。

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Wikiwand，引 Amundsen 记述）
sources.quote: Those stores proved inadequate, so Amundsen killed some of the dogs for food, which he later wrote he enjoyed, writing: "it is anything but a real hardship to eat dog flesh."

sources.title: 罗阿尔·阿蒙森（中文维基百科）
sources.quote: 在12月14日小队中的五个人带着16只狗抵达南极点(90° 0′ S)。……小队在1912年1月25日回到大本营,只剩下11只狗。

fact: 阿蒙森放弃此前南极探险常用的厚重羊毛衣物，改用因纽特式毛皮服装；运输完全依靠滑雪板与狗拉雪橇。相比之下，斯科特依赖西伯利亚矮种马。装备路线的差别直接决定了行进速度与补给消耗。

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Encyclopaedia Britannica）
sources.quote: An experienced polar traveler, Amundsen prepared carefully for the coming journey, making a preliminary trip to deposit food supplies along the first part of his route to the pole and back. To transport his supplies, he used sled dogs, while Scott depended on Siberian ponies.

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Wikiwand，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: Amundsen eschewed the heavy wool clothing worn on earlier Antarctic attempts in favour of adopting Inuit-style furred skins.

fact: 1911年的南极没有任何国家实施有效管辖：七国对南极扇区的主权宣布集中在1908年至1942年之间，1911年时既无签证、也无入境许可与海关，更无警察与法院。探险队在南极的一切行为只受船籍国法律与队内纪律约束，营地内的争执由队长裁决。

sources.title: Antarctica: National rivalries and claims（Encyclopaedia Britannica）
sources.quote: The first half of the 20th century is the colonial period in the history of Antarctica. Between 1908 and 1942 seven nations decreed sovereignty over pie wedge-shaped sectors of the continent.

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Wikiwand，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: The painful retreat caused a quarrel within the group, and Amundsen sent Johansen and the other two men to explore King Edward VII Land.

fact: 阿蒙森此行原定目标是北极漂流，1909年皮尔里到达北极的消息使原计划失去意义，他才转向南极；「前进号」是南森的旧船，不是为这次航行新造。 Britannica 记：他用南极探险所得的款项办起了一家成功的航运企业，并购入新船「Maud」号。

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Encyclopaedia Britannica）
sources.quote: Amundsen's next plan, to drift across the North Pole in Fridtjof Nansen's old ship, the Fram, was affected by the news that the American explorer Robert E. Peary had reached the North Pole in April 1909, but he continued his preparations. ... With funds resulting from his Antarctic adventure, Amundsen established a successful shipping business. He acquired a new ship, the Maud

fact: 阿蒙森队没有对路线做过系统测绘，手里只有两张照片，却选择了一条此前无人走过的冰川路线：1911年11月，队伍用四天沿阿克塞尔·海伯格冰川爬上极地高原边缘。这条路线比斯科特的比尔德莫尔冰川路线更短、坡度更集中，是这次成功的关键技术判断之一。

sources.title: Roald Amundsen（Wikiwand，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: Using a route along the previously unknown Axel Heiberg Glacier, they arrived at the edge of the Polar Plateau on 21 November after a four-day climb.

sources.title: 罗阿尔·阿蒙森（中文维基百科）
sources.quote: 阿蒙森南极探险的成功是在于谨慎的规划、良好的装备、合适的服装、简单的前期任务(阿蒙森没有去测量他往南极的路线,有的只有两张照片)、了解狗及其乘载能力,以及有效的利用滑雪板。
